decision: 10 second time penalty 2 Penalty Points (4 points in a 12 month period) Reason The Stewards reviewed video and telemetry evidence. Cars 33 and 44 entered turn 9 with Car 33 in the lead and Car 44 slightly behind and on the inside. Car 44 was on a line that did not reach the apex of the corner, with room available to the inside. When Car 33 turned into the corner, Car 44 did not avoid contact and the left front of Car 44 contacted the right rear of Car 33. Car 44 is judged predominantly at fault.

fact: Causing a collision with car 33 in turn 9.
offence: Breach of Article 2 d) Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.

title: Offence Car 44 Causing A Collision With Car 33
